# --- Load Data and processing for merge---

```{r}

#elisaMeta <- read_csv("./outs/elisa_mergeMeta.csv")
elisaMeta <- readRDS("./outs/elisa_mergeMeta_with_offsetVisitDates.rds")
elisaMeta <- elisaMeta %>%
  mutate(FirstVisitDate = if_else(Participant == "hbvx-0009" & is.na(FirstVisitDate), 
                                  as.Date("2023-03-01"), 
                                  FirstVisitDate))
#omint optional
elisaMeta <- elisaMeta %>% filter(!str_detect(Visit, "optional"))
#define final elisa for every participant
elisaMeta <- elisaMeta %>%
  group_by(Participant) %>%
  arrange(Visit, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(
    Elisa.final = {
      # last non-NA elisa.HBsAb in this participant
      vals <- elisa.HBsAb
      vals[rev(seq_along(vals))[which(!is.na(rev(vals)))[1]]]
    }
  ) %>%
  ungroup()
colnames(elisaMeta)
#view separate study arms
hbvimmune <- elisaMeta%>%filter(Study.arm =="HBVimmune-Alum")
hbvnaiveAlum <- elisaMeta%>%filter(Study.arm =="HBVnaive-Alum")
hbvnaiveCpG <- elisaMeta%>%filter(Study.arm =="HBVnaive-CpG")
```

#---Age distribution---

```{r}
# 1. Filter and prepare data
arms <- c("HBVnaive-Alum", "HBVimmune-Alum", "HBVnaive-CpG")
plot_data <- elisaMeta %>% filter(Visit == "v1w0", Study.arm %in% arms)

# 2. Create summary table with sub-counts
stats_df <- plot_data %>%
  group_by(Study.arm) %>%
  summarize(
    total_n = n(),
    avg_age = round(mean(Age, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
    n_below = sum(Age < avg_age, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_above = sum(Age >= avg_age, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

# 3. Plot with updated labels
ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = Age)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 3, fill = "steelblue", color = "white", alpha = 0.7) +
  # Note: multiplied by 4 to match binwidth of 4
  geom_density(aes(y = after_stat(count) * 4), color = "darkblue", size = 1) +
  geom_vline(data = stats_df, aes(xintercept = avg_age), 
             color = "red", linetype = "dashed", size = 0.8) +
  geom_text(data = stats_df, aes(x = Inf, y = Inf, 
                label = paste0("Total N: ", total_n, 
                               "\nAvg: ", avg_age,
                               "\nBelow Avg: ", n_below,
                               "\nAbove Avg: ", n_above)),
            hjust = 1.1, vjust = 1.1, fontface = "bold", inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 3.5) +
  facet_wrap(~Study.arm) +
  labs(title = "Age Distribution and Density by Study Arm", y = "Count") +
  theme_minimal()



```

#---dichotomy of ELISA by age groups---
```{r}
# 1. Define Geometric Mean and Geometric SE functions for Log10
geomean_fun <- function(x) {
  10^mean(log10(x[x > 0]), na.rm = TRUE)
}

geomean_se_fun <- function(x) {
  log_x <- log10(x[x > 0])
  m <- mean(log_x, na.rm = TRUE)
  se <- sd(log_x, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(sum(!is.na(log_x)))
  data.frame(
    y = 10^m,
    ymin = 10^(m - se),
    ymax = 10^(m + se)
  )
}

# 2. Prepare and filter data
plot_data <- elisaMeta %>%
  filter(Study.arm %in% c("HBVnaive-Alum", "HBVimmune-Alum", "HBVnaive-CpG")) %>%
  # ADD THIS LINE: Remove zeros and NAs before plotting
  filter(elisa.HBsAb > 0, !is.na(elisa.HBsAb)) %>% 
  filter(
    (Study.arm == "HBVnaive-Alum" & Visit != "v1w4") |
    (Study.arm == "HBVimmune-Alum" & Visit %in% c("v1w0", "v1w1", "v1w4")) |
    (Study.arm == "HBVnaive-CpG" & !Visit %in% c("v1w4", "v3w0", "v3w1", "v3w4"))
  ) %>%
  mutate(AgeGroup = case_when(
    Study.arm == "HBVnaive-Alum" & Age < 50  ~ "Below 50",
    Study.arm == "HBVnaive-Alum" & Age >= 50  ~ "Above 50",
    Study.arm == "HBVimmune-Alum"  ~ if_else(Age < 48.0, "Below Avg (48.0)", "Above Avg (48.0)"),
    Study.arm == "HBVnaive-CpG"    ~ if_else(Age < 57.2, "Below Avg (57.2)", "Above Avg (57.2)")
  )) %>%
  mutate(Status = if_else(str_detect(AgeGroup, "Above"), "Above Average", "Below Average"))
# List of arms to analyze
arms <- c("HBVnaive-Alum", "HBVnaive-CpG")

# Filter out the baseline visit (v1w0)
post_treatment_data <- plot_data %>% 
  filter(Visit != "v1w0", Visit != "v1w1")

# Run the loop again
for (arm_name in arms) {
  arm_df <- post_treatment_data %>% filter(Study.arm == arm_name)
  
  if(length(unique(arm_df$Status)) < 2) next

  # Re-run model on post-treatment data only
  lmm_model <- lmer(log10(elisa.HBsAb) ~ Status + Visit + (1|Participant), data = arm_df)
  
  cat("\n--- LMM Results (Excluding Baseline) for Arm:", arm_name, "---\n")
  
  coef_table <- summary(lmm_model)$coefficients
  status_row <- grep("Status", rownames(coef_table), value = TRUE)
  
  if(length(status_row) > 0) {
    print(coef_table[status_row, , drop = FALSE])
  }
}
# 3. Plot with p-values
ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = Visit, y = elisa.HBsAb, group = AgeGroup, color = Status)) +
  # BACKGROUND LAYER: Individual subject lines and points
  geom_line(aes(group = Participant), color = "lightgray", alpha = 0.3, linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_point(color = "lightgray", alpha = 0.2, size = 1) +
  
  # FOREGROUND LAYER: Group Geometric Means
  stat_summary(fun = geomean_fun, geom = "line", linewidth = 1.2) +
  stat_summary(fun = geomean_fun, geom = "point", size = 3) +
  stat_summary(fun.data = geomean_se_fun, geom = "errorbar", width = 0.2) +

  facet_grid(. ~ Study.arm, scales = "free", space = "free_x") + 
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Above Average" = "blue", "Below Average" = "red")) +
  # 3. Log Ticks (Major and Minor)
  # sides = "l" adds them to the left (Y-axis)
  annotation_logticks(sides = "l", color = "gray60") + 
  
  # 4. Y-Axis Configuration
  scale_y_log10(
    # Sets major breaks at 1, 10, 100, 1000, etc.
    breaks = trans_breaks("log10", function(x) 10^x),
    # Labels as plain numbers (4, 40, 400)
    labels = label_number(accuracy = 1) 
  ) + 
  
  labs(
    title = "ELISA Trends: Group Comparison with P-Values",
    x = "Visit",
    y = "elisa.HBsAb (GeoMean +/- GeoSEM)",
    color = "Age Category"
  ) +
  ct2 +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom", strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"))


```
#---dichotomy of ELISA by BMI groups---
```{r}
# 1. Define Geometric Mean and Geometric SE functions for Log10
geomean_fun <- function(x) {
  10^mean(log10(x[x > 0]), na.rm = TRUE)
}

geomean_se_fun <- function(x) {
  log_x <- log10(x[x > 0])
  m <- mean(log_x, na.rm = TRUE)
  se <- sd(log_x, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(sum(!is.na(log_x)))
  data.frame(
    y = 10^m,
    ymin = 10^(m - se),
    ymax = 10^(m + se)
  )
}

# 2. Prepare and filter data
plot_data <- elisaMeta %>%
  filter(Study.arm %in% c("HBVnaive-Alum", "HBVimmune-Alum", "HBVnaive-CpG")) %>%
  # ADD THIS LINE: Remove zeros and NAs before plotting
  filter(elisa.HBsAb > 0, !is.na(elisa.HBsAb)) %>% 
  filter(
    (Study.arm == "HBVnaive-Alum" & Visit != "v1w4") |
    (Study.arm == "HBVimmune-Alum" & Visit %in% c("v1w0", "v1w1", "v1w4")) |
    (Study.arm == "HBVnaive-CpG" & !Visit %in% c("v1w4", "v3w0", "v3w1", "v3w4"))
  ) %>%
  mutate(BMIGroup = case_when(
    Study.arm == "HBVnaive-Alum"   ~ if_else(BMI < 26.7, "Below Avg (26.7)", "Above Avg (26.7)"),
    Study.arm == "HBVimmune-Alum"  ~ if_else(BMI < 26.3, "Below Avg (26.3)", "Above Avg (26.3)"),
    Study.arm == "HBVnaive-CpG"    ~ if_else(BMI < 28.3, "Below Avg (28.3)", "Above Avg (28.3)")
  )) %>%
  mutate(BMIStatus = if_else(str_detect(BMIGroup, "Above"), "Above Average", "Below Average"))
# List of arms to analyze
arms <- c("HBVnaive-Alum", "HBVnaive-CpG")

# Filter out the baseline visit (v1w0)
post_treatment_data <- plot_data %>% 
  filter(Visit != "v1w0", Visit != "v1w1")

# Run the loop again
for (arm_name in arms) {
  arm_df <- post_treatment_data %>% filter(Study.arm == arm_name)
  
  if(length(unique(arm_df$BMIStatus)) < 2) next

  # Re-run model on post-treatment data only
  lmm_model <- lmer(log10(elisa.HBsAb) ~ BMIStatus + Visit + (1|Participant), data = arm_df)
  
  cat("\n--- LMM Results (Excluding Baseline) for Arm:", arm_name, "---\n")
  
  coef_table <- summary(lmm_model)$coefficients
  status_row <- grep("BMIStatus", rownames(coef_table), value = TRUE)
  
  if(length(status_row) > 0) {
    print(coef_table[status_row, , drop = FALSE])
  }
}
# 3. Plot with p-values
ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = Visit, y = elisa.HBsAb, group = BMIGroup, color = BMIStatus)) +
  # BACKGROUND LAYER: Individual subject lines and points
  geom_line(aes(group = Participant), color = "lightgray", alpha = 0.3, linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_point(color = "lightgray", alpha = 0.2, size = 1) +
  
  # FOREGROUND LAYER: Group Geometric Means
  stat_summary(fun = geomean_fun, geom = "line", linewidth = 1.2) +
  stat_summary(fun = geomean_fun, geom = "point", size = 3) +
  stat_summary(fun.data = geomean_se_fun, geom = "errorbar", width = 0.2) +

  facet_grid(. ~ Study.arm, scales = "free", space = "free_x") + 
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Above Average" = "blue", "Below Average" = "red")) +
  # 3. Log Ticks (Major and Minor)
  # sides = "l" adds them to the left (Y-axis)
  annotation_logticks(sides = "l", color = "gray60") + 
  
  # 4. Y-Axis Configuration
  scale_y_log10(
    # Sets major breaks at 1, 10, 100, 1000, etc.
    breaks = trans_breaks("log10", function(x) 10^x),
    # Labels as plain numbers (4, 40, 400)
    labels = label_number(accuracy = 1) 
  ) + 
  
  labs(
    title = "ELISA Trends: Group Comparison with P-Values",
    x = "Visit",
    y = "elisa.HBsAb (GeoMean +/- GeoSEM)",
    color = "BMI Category"
  ) +
  ct2 +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom", strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"))
```
#---HBsAb vs Age correlation over time---
```{r}

# Use your post_treatment_data or plot_data
ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = Age, y = elisa.HBsAb, color = Study.arm)) +
  # Individual data points
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5) +
  # Linear regression line with confidence intervals
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE) +
  # Facet by Study.arm and Visit to see the iteration
  facet_grid(Study.arm ~ Visit, scales = "free") +
  # Use log10 for ELISA titers as previously discussed
  scale_y_continuous(trans = "log10") +
  # Automatically add correlation coefficient (R) and p-value per facet
stat_cor(method = "pearson", 
           label.x.npc = "left", 
           label.y.npc = "top",
           label.sep = "\n", 
           size = 2,
           vjust = 3) + 
  labs(title = "Correlation Between Age and ELISA Titers Over Time",
       x = "Age (Years)", y = "elisa.HBsAb (Log10)") +
  theme_minimal()+
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 7), # Smaller x-axis numbers
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 6), # Smaller y-axis numbers
    strip.text = element_text(size = 8),  # Optional: Smaller facet titles
    legend.position = "none")

```
